title: The Case for Doing Nothing
author: LinguaTrek 编辑部
summary: A short life read about rest, boredom, and why an empty minute is not a wasted one.

paragraphs.en: We live in a busy world. We work, study, scroll through our phones, and plan the next thing. Many of us feel guilty when we are not doing something useful. But doing nothing is not always a waste of time.
paragraphs.zh: 我们生活在一个忙碌的世界里。我们工作、学习、刷手机，还计划着下一件事。很多人一闲下来没做"有用的事"，就会感到内疚。但什么都不做，并不总是浪费时间。

paragraphs.en: Your brain needs rest. When you sit quietly, your mind can sort through the day. Scientists say that short breaks help us remember better and feel less tired.
paragraphs.zh: 你的大脑需要休息。当你安静地坐着时，大脑可以整理一天的经历。科学家说，短暂休息能帮助我们记得更牢，也没那么容易累。

paragraphs.en: Some people think rest must be earned. They finish a task, and then allow themselves five minutes. But your brain is not a machine that only stops when the work is done. It needs small pauses all day long.
paragraphs.zh: 有些人认为休息必须靠努力换来。他们完成一项任务，才允许自己休息五分钟。但你的大脑不是一台只在工作结束后才停机的机器。它一整天都需要小小的停顿。

paragraphs.en: Unfortunately, many of us fill every empty moment with a screen. We check messages while waiting for a bus, and we watch videos while eating. Our brains rarely get a quiet minute.
paragraphs.zh: 遗憾的是，我们很多人用屏幕填满了每一个空闲时刻。等公交时看消息，吃饭时看视频。我们的大脑很少有一分钟安静的时间。

paragraphs.en: Boredom can also be useful. When there is nothing to watch, your imagination starts to work. Some of our best ideas come when we are walking, waiting, or looking out of a window.
paragraphs.zh: 无聊也可能有用。当没有什么可看的时候，想象力就开始工作。我们最好的点子，有些正是出现在散步、等待或望向窗外的时候。

paragraphs.en: Rest is not the same as laziness. Laziness means avoiding things you should do. Rest means giving your body and mind time to recover, so you can do those things later.
paragraphs.zh: 休息和懒惰不是一回事。懒惰是逃避你应该做的事；休息则是给身体和大脑恢复的时间，好让你之后能去做那些事。

paragraphs.en: Try it today. Put down your phone for ten minutes. Sit somewhere quiet. Look at the sky. Let your thoughts come and go. You do not need to fix anything or finish anything.
paragraphs.zh: 今天就试一试。把手机放下十分钟。找个安静的地方坐着。看看天空。让念头来来去去。你不需要修好什么，也不需要完成什么。

paragraphs.en: At first, it may feel strange. But after a while, doing nothing can feel like a small holiday. And you may return to your work with a clearer head and a lighter heart.
paragraphs.zh: 一开始，你可能会觉得奇怪。但过一阵子，什么都不做会像一个小小的假期。等你回到工作中时，头脑也许会更清醒，心情也会更轻松。
